```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(terra)
library(tidyterra)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggspatial)
library(patchwork)

checkpoint_dir <- "checkpoints"
utm_crs <- 32611
```

## Building the distance-to-road raster (general accessibility)

```{r dist-road-build}
ndvi_stack_utm <- rast(file.path(checkpoint_dir, "ndvi_stack_utm.tif"))
osm_roads_utm  <- readRDS(file.path(checkpoint_dir, "osm_roads_utm.rds"))

template <- ndvi_stack_utm[[1]]                       # extent/resolution/CRS template

roads_mask <- rasterize(vect(osm_roads_utm), template, field = 1, background = NA)
dist_road_raster <- distance(roads_mask)               # metres to nearest road (any class)
names(dist_road_raster) <- "dist_to_road_m"

summary(values(dist_road_raster))
```

## Distance-to-road map

```{r dist-road-map, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = dist_road_raster) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("#3f007d", "#807dba", "#bcbddc", "#f2f0f7"),
    na.value = NA, name = "Distance to\nroad (m)", trans = "sqrt"
  ) +
  annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.25) +
  annotation_north_arrow(location = "tr", style = north_arrow_minimal()) +
  labs(title = "Distance to nearest road", subtitle = "General accessibility surface (all path classes)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank())
```

## Traffic-exposure surface (vehicle-capable roads only)

```{r dist-traffic-build}
non_vehicle_classes <- c("footway", "path", "steps", "cycleway", "pedestrian",
                          "bridleway", "corridor", "elevator", "proposed",
                          "planned", "construction")

traffic_roads_utm <- osm_roads_utm %>% filter(!(highway %in% non_vehicle_classes))

traffic_mask <- rasterize(vect(traffic_roads_utm), template, field = 1, background = NA)
dist_traffic_raster <- distance(traffic_mask)
names(dist_traffic_raster) <- "dist_to_traffic_road_m"

summary(values(dist_traffic_raster))
```

## Comparison: general accessibility vs traffic exposure

```{r dist-compare, fig.width=13, fig.height=7}
shared_scale <- scale_fill_gradientn(
  colours = c("#3f007d", "#807dba", "#bcbddc", "#f2f0f7"),
  na.value = NA, name = "Distance\n(m)", trans = "sqrt",
  limits = c(0, max(values(dist_traffic_raster), na.rm = TRUE))  # same scale, both panels
)

panel_access <- ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = dist_road_raster) + shared_scale +
  labs(title = "General human accessibility", subtitle = "All path classes") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")

panel_traffic <- ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = dist_traffic_raster) + shared_scale +
  annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.3) +
  labs(title = "Actual traffic exposure", subtitle = "Vehicle-capable roads only") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank())

panel_access + panel_traffic +
  plot_annotation(title = "Human accessibility vs traffic exposure",
                   subtitle = "Same colour scale on both panels")
```

```{r dist-stats}
tibble::tibble(
  surface = c("General accessibility", "Traffic exposure"),
  median_m = c(median(values(dist_road_raster), na.rm = TRUE),
               median(values(dist_traffic_raster), na.rm = TRUE)),
  mean_m   = c(mean(values(dist_road_raster), na.rm = TRUE),
               mean(values(dist_traffic_raster), na.rm = TRUE)),
  max_m    = c(max(values(dist_road_raster), na.rm = TRUE),
               max(values(dist_traffic_raster), na.rm = TRUE))
)
```

```{r dist-checkpoint, eval=FALSE}
# save for reuse in downstream scripts
writeRaster(dist_road_raster, file.path(checkpoint_dir, "dist_road_raster.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
writeRaster(dist_traffic_raster, file.path(checkpoint_dir, "dist_traffic_raster.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
```
